answer.explanation: The domain class Subscription imports and instantiates SystemClock, an outbound adapter, at src/domain/subscription.ts:1 and :4. It calls clock.now() in isActive(). The core therefore depends directly on an adapter (infrastructure/I/O: reading system time), which FF-S04 flags because core code must not depend on adapters. ADR-0002 once allowed this import, but it is Superseded by ADR-0009. ADR-0009 is Accepted and says the core must not import SystemClock or any other adapter. The core should depend on a Clock port in src/domain that the adapter implements. The finding therefore contradicts the declared intent, and no current doc grants an exception.
